title: 第22章 替死鬼第23章 登门
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
宋仁满头大汗的回想那天王麻子说的话：“好...好像是外地人，来云梦城好久了。”
“就她们母女两人？”
“好像就她们母女两人。”
啪的一声，杜尚又一巴掌甩在了宋仁的脸上，宋仁倒在地上只感觉脑袋嗡嗡作响。
“就她们母女两人有什么好说的，已死之人还能从坟里面爬出来报仇吗！”
“林秋，你觉得呢？”
林秋想了一会说道：“他们得罪的人太多了，无法确定凶手是谁，如果大动干戈的话，怕会惊动真正的凶手，到时候要是凶手躲起来报复我们，那可就不妙了。”
杜尚不屑的一笑：“一个只敢下迷药的家伙，要是他敢来，我一拳就送他上西天！”
“老大，明枪易躲暗箭难防，现在还不知道凶手是怎么做到把他们变成干尸的。”
“就算我们不怕，手底下的人可未必能够防得住啊。”
听完林秋说的，杜尚一个头两个大，于是说道：“那你说该怎么办，这件事情要是没有个交代，那其他大头目一定会落井下石的。”
林秋低头看向还在地上捂着脸的宋仁说道：“凶手不就是想要报仇吗，那就帮他报仇好了！”
“嗯？你的意思是？”杜尚疑惑的看着林秋。
面对杜尚的疑惑，林秋说道：“既然凶手目的是为了报仇，那就直接帮他把仇家处理了，这样他的仇报了，也就不会盯着我们不放。”
“我们也不用面对一个手段诡异的人，岂不是两全其美。”
“你说对吧，杀害王麻子一群人，然后盗走银子的凶手，宋仁！”
此时宋仁才从那一巴掌中缓过神来，还不清楚林秋说了什么。
只是一抬头就看见林秋面带诡异的看着他，而杜尚也一开始也有点懵，但等理解林秋的意思之后，直接哈哈大笑起来。
看向宋仁的眼神也和蔼了起来，走上前去，扶起宋仁说道：“你刚才是说为了帮里流过血对吧？”
宋仁一脸懵逼的看着突然和善起来的杜尚，虽然不明白怎么回事，但是直接回答是肯定没错。

“对啊，大头目，我对帮里忠心耿耿，您一定要救救我啊。”
“那好，现在帮里有一件事情要你去做，”杜尚拍了拍宋仁肩膀。
“您说，大头目，我一定为帮里赴汤蹈火，在所不辞！”宋仁此时满脸坚定，为帮里赴汤蹈火不一定死，但是遇到凶手那真的是死定了。
“好好好！”杜尚连声叫好，但下一瞬，和蔼的面孔消失不见，取而代之的是凶狠。
还没等宋仁反应过来，只觉得胸膛传来剧痛，身体瞬间被击飞了出去，还没等倒地就已经带着疑惑跟不解死去！
杜尚收回拳头，看也不看倒在地上死不瞑目的宋仁，向大门口喊道：“进来收尸了！”
等手下进来之后，杜尚指了指宋仁的尸体说道：“这小子贼喊捉贼，想要独吞保护费，就杀了其他人，把他尸体拖下去剁碎了喂狗。”
“顺便跟手底下其他人说下，手脚都干净点，不然下场就跟他一样。”
一众手下急忙点头，生怕惹怒了杜尚，然后便拖着宋仁跟其他干尸的尸体下去处理了。
等他们走了之后，杜尚对林秋说道：“现在这个据点没人了，你赶紧安排一些人过来，记得，手脚要干净，也别再给我惹出什么事情来！”
“对了，朝阳坊那边的事情你也知道的，既然背后有旭日武馆，那就先不收那边的保护费了，其他地方的保护费再加一点上来。”
林秋点了点头：“好的，老大，我这边会安排好的。”
杜尚拍了拍林秋的肩膀：“嗯，好好干，等你突破到练肉境界，到时候我推荐你当大头目。”
content_en:
Song Ren was sweating profusely as he recalled what Wang Mazi said that day: "Okay... It seems like he is an outsider. He has been in Yunmeng City for a long time."
"Just mother and daughter?"
"It seems like it's just the mother and daughter."
With a snap, Dushan slapped Song Ren on the face again. Song Ren fell to the ground and felt his head buzzing.
"What can the mother and daughter have to say? How can a dead person crawl out of the grave to seek revenge?"
"Lin Qiu, what do you think?"
Lin Qiu thought for a while and said: "They have offended too many people and cannot be sure who the murderer is. If they start a big fight, they may alert the real murderer. If the murderer hides and takes revenge on us, it will not be good."
Dushan smiled disdainfully: "A guy who only dares to take drugs. If he dares to come, I will send him to the West with one punch!"
"Boss, it's easy to hide from open guns and hard to defend against hidden arrows. We still don't know how the murderer managed to turn them into mummies."
"Even if we are not afraid, the people under our control may not be able to guard against it."
After listening to what Lin Qiu said, Du Shang was stunned, so he said: "Then what should you do? If there is no explanation for this matter, the other big bosses will definitely make things worse."
Lin Qiu looked down at Song Ren, who was still covering his face on the ground, and said, "The murderer just wants revenge, so let's help him get revenge!"
"Huh? What do you mean?" Du Shang looked at Lin Qiu doubtfully.
Faced with Du Shang's doubts, Lin Qiu said: "Since the murderer's purpose is revenge, let's help him deal with his enemies directly. This way, he will not keep an eye on us after his revenge is avenged."
"We also don't have to face a person with weird methods. Isn't it the best of both worlds?"
"Are you right? Song Ren is the murderer who killed Wang Mazi's group of people and then stole the money!"
At this time, Song Ren had just recovered from the slap, and he still didn't know what Lin Qiu said.
As soon as he raised his head, he saw Lin Qiu looking at him with a strange expression. Dushan was also a little confused at first, but after understanding what Lin Qiu meant, he burst out laughing.
The eyes he looked at Song Ren became kinder, he walked forward, helped Song Ren up and said, "You just said you shed blood for the gang, right?"
Song Ren looked at Du Shang who suddenly became friendly with a confused expression. Although he didn't understand what was going on, he answered directly that he was definitely right.
"Yes, big boss, I am loyal to the gang, you must save me."
"Well, now the gang has something for you to do," Dushan patted Song Ren on the shoulder.
"You said, big boss, I will go through fire and water for the gang, no matter what!" Song Ren's face was full of determination at this time. Going through fire and water for the gang may not necessarily lead to death, but if you meet the murderer, you will really die.
"Okay, okay!" Dushan shouted repeatedly, but in the next moment, the kind face disappeared and was replaced by fierceness.
Before Song Ren could react, he felt severe pain in his chest, and his body was instantly knocked out. He died with doubts and confusion before he fell to the ground!
Dushan retracted his fist, and without even looking at Song Ren, who was lying on the ground and dying, he shouted to the door: "Come in and collect the corpse!"
After his men came in, Du Shang pointed to Song Ren's body and said: "This kid wanted to catch the thief. He wanted to monopolize the protection money, so he killed other people, dragged his body down, chopped it up and fed it to the dogs."
"By the way, I would like to tell the other people under my command to keep their hands and feet clean, otherwise they will end up like him."
The men nodded hurriedly, fearing to offend Du Shang, and then dragged Song Ren and the other mummified bodies down to dispose of them.
After they left, Du Shang said to Lin Qiu: "There is no one in this stronghold now. You should quickly arrange for some people to come over. Remember, your hands and feet must be clean, and don't cause any trouble for me again!"
"By the way, you also know what's going on over at Chaoyangfang. Since there's the Rising Sun Martial Arts School behind you, let's not take in the security guards there first.If the protection fee is paid, the protection fees from other places will be added on top of that. "
Lin Qiu nodded: "Okay, boss, I will make arrangements here. "
Du Shang patted Lin Qiu on the shoulder: "Well, work hard, and when you break through to the realm of meat training, I will recommend you to be the big boss. "
